# Dominiq

> Dominiq is AI compliance software for Tier 2 and Tier 3 U.S. defense subcontractors. It classifies ITAR and CUI files, maps evidence to the 110 NIST SP 800-171 requirements, and vets suppliers against the clauses a company flows down to them. Dominiq is pre-launch; demos and early access are by email at team@dominiq.site.

Dominiq is for the operations manager or office lead at a small defense manufacturer — a machine shop, electronics builder or specialty supplier — who owns the company's SPRS score without a dedicated compliance department.

## What the product does

- Connects through read-only connectors to SharePoint, OneDrive, shop file servers and mailboxes. Files are not moved or copied out of the customer's environment.
- Classifies files by reading export legends, distribution statements, drawing title blocks and CUI banners in context. Low-confidence calls go to a human review queue.
- Traces who opened controlled files and flags controlled files leaving their boundary, such as being emailed to a personal account.
- Maps evidence to each of the 110 NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 requirements and estimates an SPRS score with the DoD Assessment Methodology.
- Drafts System Security Plan text and POA&M items, with open items tracked against the 180-day closeout window.
- Answers plain-English questions about who can open a file and what that access means under ITAR, then drafts a fix for a human to approve.
- Sends flow-down questionnaires to suppliers, collects SPRS scores and affirmations, and keeps a ledger of which suppliers received which clauses.
- Starts the 72-hour DFARS 252.204-7012 reporting clock when a possible CUI incident is detected and lists the steps: contain, preserve images for at least 90 days, report through DIBNet.

## What a customer gets

- An SPRS estimate tied line by line to evidence
- A System Security Plan and POA&M that match what is actually configured
- An inventory of every ITAR and CUI file: where it lives, how it is marked and who has opened it
- A flow-down ledger of suppliers

## Data handling

Dominiq is designed to run inside the customer's own Microsoft 365 GCC High or Azure Government tenant through read-only connectors, so files are not copied out and the Dominiq team does not need access to them. Dominiq does not issue CMMC certifications and is not legal or export-control advice.

## Regulatory context (as of 3 November 2026)

- CMMC Phase 2 third-party certification has been suspended since 13 July 2026, with restart options under review.
- Phase 1 self-assessments and annual SPRS affirmations remain in force, as they have since 10 November 2025.
- DFARS 252.204-7012 requires NIST SP 800-171, 72-hour cyber incident reporting and flow-down to subcontracts.
- Sources are listed at https://dominiq.site/#sources
